Mayfly Ventures is seeking an experienced Developer Programmer to join our team on a full-time basis. This is a hands-on, end-to-end product delivery role in which you will architect, design, build, and maintain web and mobile applications across concurrent client and in-house venture projects.

application functionality

• Experience working across multiple industries including fintech, health, education, logistics, or hospitality technology sectors

Interested candidates should submit a current resume, a cover letter addressing the key

IT Systems & Support Technician (Industrial Automation)

About our client 

Kogan People Solutions has been retained by a leading automotive components manufacturer to recruit a highly focused tech professional for their automated production facility. Our client operates a state of  the art, continuous manufacturing environment where 100% of finished products undergo sophisticated, computer controlled validation before release. Due to operational expansion and the critical nature of their systems, we are seeking a dedicated IT Systems Support Technician to ensure their core industrial computing infrastructure remains online and optimized.

Role Overview
This is a highly specialized, business-critical role embedded directly within an advanced manufacturing environment. You will be responsible for the continuous, real-time monitoring of two advanced Turbo Test Duo balancing and calibration systems driven by embedded software platforms.

To confirm: This is not a mechanical repair position. The primary objective is the maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of the highly integrated computer systems, hardware interfaces, and proprietary software that governs the physical machinery.

Location: Cheltenham, VIC

Job Type: Full-time, Ongoing 

Salary $80,000 – $90,000 + Superannuation  per annum.

Responsibilities 
•	Actively oversee and analyze the operation of embedded, computer-controlled industrial systems throughout the day.

•	Instantly respond to automated software alerts and digital system alarms to isolate faults across integrated computer hardware and data logging modules.

•	Resolve complex technical issues occurring within specialized proprietary software configurations and peripheral IT components.

•	Manage, verify, and update software profiles, system parameters, and computer calibration data to guarantee operational accuracy.

•	Maintain precise digital records of system errors, technical configurations, and software performance logs to feed into predictive risk management.

Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience

•	Diploma, or higher qualification in a highly related IT discipline or agreed substitute

•	Experience: Minimum of 1–2 years of professional experience supporting integrated computer networks, automated software platforms, or industrial IT hardware interfaces.

•	Proven experience interpreting real-time software diagnostics, system logs, and bi-directional hardware/software integration.

•	Strong ability to diagnose computing faults rapidly under pressure to minimize production downtime. 

•	Excellent communication skills to interface with production engineers.

•	Ability to prioritise, multitask and work independently.

•	A passion for learning and staying ahead of technology trends.

•	Ability to analyse and evaluate complex IT issues.

•	High attention to detail and documentation accuracy

You will have unrestricted rights to work full time in Australia to be considered. 

How to Apply

If you possess the specialized IT skills required to support critical, automated industrial computing infrastructure, Kogan People Solutions wants to hear from you. Accompanying your application, we would prefer to see a cover letter detailing your specific software and hardware troubleshooting experience

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

Glenorie, Sydney NSW 2157

Full Time Life Scientist 
$80,000 p.a.

Summary
The Life Scientist is responsible for gathering scientific data, designing experiments, and executing upstream and downstream manufacturing processes for microbiological vaccines. 
The position involves interaction with Research and Development partners to ensure the scientific content and approach in R&D experiments meet suitable GMP and GLP standards, guaranteeing a timely outcome for the Company. The ideal candidate combines meticulous execution with strict adherence to biosecurity, quality assurance, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). 

Key Responsibilities
•	Design and conduct complex experiments, record precise observations/measurements, analyse biological data, and prepare or supervise the preparation of laboratory reports. 
•	Ensure the environmental conditions for each of the current vaccine products are suitable for maximum multiplication to maximise the efficacy of the resulting live veterinary vaccine. 
•	Provide scientific knowledge and biotechnological input to new potential products in research and development phases to ensure efficient transfer and scale up to manufacturing. 
•	Support laboratory scientists in the research, development, and scale-up of biotechnological processes, including assisting in the design of Development Record Sheets. 
•	Review and analyse data to make meaningful conclusions and outcomes, presenting data and trial results to BPL Management and R&D teams. 
•	Inoculate, propagate, and harvest live microbiological strains used in vaccine production. 
•	Perform aseptic techniques and sterile manipulations within cleanroom environments. 
•	Carry out cleanroom setup prior to production and perform line clearance after production activities. 
•	Perform decontamination of production waste using validated autoclave systems. 
•	Prepare, package, and handle biological materials including vials and bottles for sterilisation. 
•	Critically review completed general production/laboratory documentation (production batch records, environmental monitoring records) for the operation of biotechnology equipment with a strict emphasis on product quality standards and GMP compliance. 
•	Write and/or review Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Production Record Sheets (PRSs), and other controlled documents as required. 
•	Ensure compliance with biosecurity regulations and applicable regulatory requirements. 
•	Perform Risk Assessments, Corrective and Preventative (CAPA) investigations, raise Deviation/Incident Reports (DIR), and initiate Change Controls (CC) when necessary, including root cause analysis in biotechnology deviations. 
•	Support documentation control for viral, bacterial, and mycoplasma strains. 

Qualification & Experience
•	Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Science, Biotechnology, Microbiology, or a highly related discipline. 
•	At least 1+ years of relevant industry experience in life sciences or pharmaceutical GMP quality vaccine manufacturing.  
•	Experience working in a laboratory or biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment. 
•	Exposure to microbial culture handling. 
•	Familiarity with GMP standards, documentation practices, and quality assurance control systems. 
•	High attention to detail with strong commitment to quality and compliance.
•	Ability to follow strict protocols and work in a regulated environment.
•	Strong teamwork and communication skills.

## Chief Information Officer
## Position Overview
We are looking for a visionary and commercially astute Chief Information Officer (CIO) to lead our organisation's information and communications technology strategy, operations, and governance. This is a senior executive role suited to an experienced technology leader who thrives at the intersection of business strategy and digital innovation. The successful candidate will be responsible for aligning ICT capabilities with organisational priorities, driving transformation, and ensuring the long-term integrity and security of our technology infrastructure.
## Key Responsibilities
- Analyse organisational information needs and define technology solutions that effectively support business objectives and operational performance
- Formulate, implement, and continuously refine ICT strategies, policies, and plans that align with the organisation's broader mission and priorities
- Lead the selection, procurement, and installation of ICT systems and infrastructure, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, and fit for purpose
- Direct ICT operations across the organisation, setting clear priorities between system development, ongoing maintenance, and day-to-day operations
- Oversee the organisation's cybersecurity posture, ensuring robust protections are in place to safeguard data, systems, and digital assets
- Drive digital transformation initiatives that improve organisational efficiency, enhance service delivery, and support innovation
- Develop and manage the ICT budget, ensuring effective allocation of resources and demonstrable return on technology investment
- Build, mentor, and lead high-performing ICT teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development
- Engage and manage relationships with external technology vendors, partners, and service providers to ensure contractual obligations and service standards are met
- Champion the rollout of user training programmes to ensure staff are equipped to effectively adopt and utilise ICT systems and tools
- Provide executive-level reporting and strategic advice to the Board and senior leadership team on technology risks, opportunities, and performance
- Ensure ICT systems and practices remain compliant with relevant legislation, industry standards, and data governance frameworks
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a senior ICT leadership role, with a strong track record of delivering enterprise-wide technology strategy
- Proven ability to align ICT capability with organisational strategy and drive measurable business outcomes
- Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, risk management, and data governance best practices
- Experience managing large-scale ICT budgets, procurement processes, and vendor relationships
- Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to inspire, develop, and retain high-performing teams
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a strategic mindset and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
- Sound knowledge of ICT infrastructure, cloud environments, enterprise systems, and emerging technologies
- High-level communication, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement skills across all levels of an organisation
## Preferred Qualifications
- Postgraduate qualification in Business Administration (MBA), Information Technology, or a related field
- Industry certifications such as ITIL, TOGAF, CISSP, or equivalent
- Experience leading digital transformation programmes within complex or large-scale organisations
- Familiarity with Australian data privacy legislation, including the Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles
- Prior experience presenting to executive leadership teams or Boards of Directors
## Why Join Us?
- Play a pivotal role in shaping the digital future of a dynamic and growing organisation, with genuine influence at the executive level
- Access to ongoing professional development opportunities, including leadership programmes, industry conferences, and certifications
- Flexible working arrangements that support a healthy work-life balance
- Collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values innovation, integrity, and continuous improvement
- Competitive remuneration package with performance-based incentives and additional employee benefits
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation
